scene_analysis.scene_overview: A bright blue sky with white clouds over a city street with tall buildings and pedestrians crossing the street. The sun is shining brightly, casting shadows on the ground. A yellow DHL van is parked along the curb, with a few people walking by. The street is lined with tall buildings, some with balconies and others with large windows. There are also several trees and streetlights along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are mostly white and brown, with some having balconies and others having large windows. Some have a more modern look, while others appear older.
scene_analysis.materials: The DHL van has a yellow body with a black stripe running along the bottom. It has a large logo on the side that says 'DHL' in bold red letters.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked against the wall.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are a few trees and bushes along the sidewalk, but they are sparse and not very dense.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a parking sign and a directional sign pointing to different parts of the city.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street appears to be quiet, with only a few people out and about.
